headline: Binance Reports $6.3B Security Breach and Suspends Withdrawals
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance reported a $6.3 billion security breach, prompting the temporary suspension of withdrawals while security revamps are completed. The platform pledged to cover user losses.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or suspensions can impact market confidence and liquidity across digital assets.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: A massive security breach and withdrawal suspension directly impacts platform operations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A major security breach valued at billions of dollars and the subsequent suspension of withdrawals severely disrupts platform operations and raises concerns over digital asset security.
